subject: Post-call: Procurement routing & security evidence needed for Brightleaf
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Halpern <t.halpern@brightleaf.health>; procurement@brightleaf.health
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Procurement routing & security evidence needed for Brightleaf

Hi Tom / Brightleaf procurement team,

Thanks for the time today — great to learn more about the ingestion volume and the compliance constraints that will drive your procurement route. Quick recap and asks so we’re aligned: 

- You ran the demo with the data-team use case and confirmed production traffic will be ~1.2M tokens/day after month 1.
- You mentioned procurement prefers an invoice / PO flow but you were open to Marketplace if it shortens legal turn-around.
- Security gate: SOC 2 attestation + executed DPA required before production. You also flagged two questionnaire items that need architecture notes (data residency and KV cache retention).

Actions / asks (can you confirm by EOD Thu?):
1) Procurement preference: PO/invoice or card/marketplace? If PO, what is your typical PO lead time?
2) Who should I send the DPA for signature? (email + name of the signee)
3) Please attach the security questionnaire PDF (or link) — we’ll map the answers and return a redlined DPA where needed.
4) Any required contractual terms we should expect (IP/indemnity/insurance limits)?

I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary and our standard DPA template to accelerate the internal review. Ben will follow up on billing/pricing terms once we confirm invoicing preferences.

Next internal step: Marissa — if procurement signals PO, we’ll queue the legal review and prepare the paperflow checklist for a PO commit.

Thanks,

--
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
- Standard_DPA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx (editable)

From: Tom Halpern <t.halpern@brightleaf.health>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightleaf.health; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement routing & security evidence needed for Brightleaf

Camila — thanks for the summary and the docs. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement preference: primary is PO / invoice. Typical PO lead time is 4–6 weeks once legal signs off. We have a pilot budget and could use a procurement card for an initial POC (up to $5k) if that helps accelerate a pilot.

2) DPA signee: procurement@brightleaf.health is the best inbox; final signature will be by Melanie Ortiz (Head of Legal) — melanie.ortiz@brightleaf.health.

3) Questionnaire: attaching the security questionnaire (Brightleaf_Security_Q_2026.pdf). Key unresolved items you’ll see: data residency (we need EU-only for PHI-processing subcomponents), and confirmation on KV cache retention and deletion timing.

4) Contract terms to watch: insurance minimums are listed in the questionnaire; we generally don’t accept changes to IP clauses but we reserve the right to ask for more specific audit clauses for cloud-hosted vendors.

Happy to run this in parallel — Ben, if you can confirm whether a Marketplace purchase would trigger different pricing or prevent a PO later (we want to avoid marketplace-forget).

Best,
Tom

Attachments:
- Brightleaf_Security_Q_2026.pdf (security questionnaire)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Halpern <t.halpern@brightleaf.health>; procurement@brightleaf.health
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement routing & security evidence needed for Brightleaf

Tom — quick note on the commercial side: 

- Marketplace purchases generally use card transactions and can get you live in <48 hours, but they do not create a POable contract for later invoicing without a separate migration process. If you plan to do a full production rollout under a PO, I recommend we run pilot on card (small spend) and start legal on the PO/MSA in parallel.
- Pricing: for pilots we can provide a pilot credit of $4k and a 10% pilot discount if you commit to a 3-month pilot and sign the DPA. 

Camila / Marissa, can we prepare two parallel paths: (A) Marketplace pilot + signed DPA for immediate pilot, (B) PO/MSA routing — estimate 4–6 week legal timeline. I’ll draft the short win-criteria for the pilot so procurement can justify the card spend.

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment references: none (SOC2/DPA already provided)

3) Ben will open the pilot credit paperwork (he’ll send the pilot SOW) so you can do the POC via card while legal works the PO path.
